summary: Added an observability-only atomic-work telemetry compiler inside the existing control-room-stats owner. It derives PRODUCER/VERIFIER/CRITIC/INTEGRATOR/RECOVERY task classes and queue_wait/claim_to_start/execution/claim_to_complete/fan_in_wait stages from existing durable PIN, STARTED, RETURN, Guide receipt and no-allocation evidence. It emits p50 plus p95/outliers only with sufficient samples, useful_yield as consumed durable return refs divided by completed durable units, and collision/retry/transport-boundary counters without creating a second authoritative ledger.
tests: Check atomic work telemetry derivation => PASS
All pre-existing Efficiency Ratchet checks in the same run => PASS
Synthetic fixture proves three verifier samples expose P50/P95/outlier contract, Guide fan-in resolves exact return refs, useful_yield=2/4, collisions and transport/retry counters remain class-scoped
Missing first-material-write and separate verification-stage timestamps remain explicitly UNKNOWN rather than fabricated

feature_evidence.requirement: Define task_class and stage_class from existing owners
feature_evidence.evidence: Compiler exposes fixed task_classes PRODUCER/VERIFIER/CRITIC/INTEGRATOR/RECOVERY and stage_classes queue_wait/claim_to_start/execution/claim_to_complete/fan_in_wait.

feature_evidence.requirement: Project p50/p95/outliers by class when data is sufficient
feature_evidence.evidence: summary() emits P50 always when observed and P95/outlier fields only at >=3 durable samples; CI fixture covers the sufficient-data path.

feature_evidence.requirement: Measure useful_yield as consumed returns / executed units
feature_evidence.evidence: Compiler deduplicates exact consumed return refs from Guide receipts and divides by completed portfolio-return + guide-receipt units.

feature_evidence.requirement: Separate queue/claim wait, execution and fan-in wait
feature_evidence.evidence: Distinct stage buckets are derived only when both durable endpoints exist; unresolved endpoints remain null/unknown.
No-allocation evidence is classified through existing job/role context and counted per task class; CI fixture covers collision plus retry/transport boundary.

feature_evidence.requirement: Persist projection/harness from existing durable events without second authority
feature_evidence.evidence: Reusable CLI compiler + bound regression live under existing coordination/analytics/control-room-stats-v1 owner with authority OBSERVABILITY_ONLY.

truth_boundary: Telemetry is derived observability only. It grants no liveness, scheduler, claim, CURRENT, acceptance or completion authority. Hidden reasoning time is not measured. Missing durable timestamps remain unknown.
unresolved: First-material-write timing remains unavailable until an existing owner durably normalizes that timestamp.
Separate verification-stage duration remains unavailable when no distinct durable verification timestamp exists.
